text:
Alex Kim: Hey @people-ops I just got an email titled "Dependent Verification Audit" asking for docs for my spouse. Deadline says 10 business days. What exactly do I need to send? Can I upload scans? Do I need to include SSN? Thanks!

Maria (People Ops): Hi Alex — sorry for the alarm. For spouse we accept a marriage certificate OR a government-issued marriage record plus one of: joint lease, joint bank statement, joint mortgage, or domestic partner affidavit. For dependents (child) it's birth certificate OR adoption decree. Scans are fine as PDFs or images. If doc includes SSN, you may redact all but last 4 digits. Please don't send photos via email — use the secure upload link in the audit email.

Alex Kim: Thanks! The marriage cert is in Korean — do you need a translation/apostille?

Jamie - Benefits: Hi Alex — if the document is not in English, we need a certified translation (one page) or a notarized translation. An apostille is NOT required for most countries but is accepted. If you want we can accept a stamped translation from a local notary. Please upload both original and translation.

Alex Kim: Got it. The audit email has a link that looks like https://uploads.redwoodhr.com/ev/abc123 — is that legit?

Maria (People Ops): Yes that's our secure vendor portal (DocuSecure). It expires after the deadline. Do not upload to public cloud drives. If you have issues, reply here and we can open a case for manual intake.

Alex Kim: If I miss the 10 business day deadline, will coverage be canceled? Payroll adjusted?

Sam (Payroll): If docs are not provided by the deadline, we may suspend dependent coverage prospectively and initiate payroll correction retroactively to remove employer contributions. If you later provide docs within the appeal window, we typically reinstate coverage with retro paybacks but it can be messy. Best to upload on time.

Alex Kim: Ok will upload today. One last q: can I redact the child's DOB? It's on the birth cert.

Jamie - Benefits: Please do NOT redact DOB or names — those are needed to verify. Only allowed redaction is SSN (all but last 4).

BenefitsBot: Reminder: Upload deadline 2025-05-02 23:59 PT. Link in audit email. Questions? Reply in this thread or email people-ops@redwood.com :bell:
